events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Lane Hutson scored on a slap shot at 2:09 of overtime and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 3-2 on Friday night to take a 2-1 lead in the first-round series that has opened with three extra-time thrillers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Canadiens beat Lightning 3-2 in OT to take 2-1 lead in all extra-time series

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Utah Mammoth

headlines.description: — Lawson Crouse scored twice in a 5:42 span in the second period and the Utah Mammoth won the first NHL playoff game in the state, beating the Vegas Golden Knights 4-2 on Friday night for a 2-1 series lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mammoth win the first NHL playoff game in Utah, beating Vegas 4-2 for 2-1 series lead

headlines.shortLinkText: Ducks blast Oilers 7-4 in Game 3 in Anaheim's first home playoff game in 8 years
